description: Import PDF documents and ask questions about their contents with ChatPDF. Use document outputs in reporting, information extraction, or document-review workflows. Start with a clearly identified source file or template, then check whether the generated, parsed, or question-answering result matches the intended task. Tables, complex layouts, and scanned material may require additional review. Verify important numbers and quotations against the source document before incorporating them into a final report or operational decision.
description_cn: 导入 PDF 文档并针对文档内容进行问答。适合把文档内容与业务流程连接起来，辅助准备报告、提取资料或核对文档信息。可围绕明确的输入文件或模板组织处理过程，并检查生成、解析或问答结果是否符合预期。表格、复杂版式和扫描内容可能需要额外复核，关键数字与引用应回到原始文档确认。
